title.rendered: Endued With Power From on High: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Endued with power from on high. Jesus said it. The Spirit fulfilled it. You have been clothed with a power that did not begin in you. Walk in it today.

content.rendered:
Endued with power from on high. Jesus said it. The Spirit fulfilled it. You have been clothed with a power that did not begin in you and cannot be exhausted by you. Walk in it today.

The Gospel For Today | Thursday, May 21, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.”
Luke 24:49 (KJV)

Today’s Message

Pay attention to one word in this verse. Endued. The King James translators picked it carefully. It is the English of the Greek word enduo, which literally means to put on clothing, to be invested with, to be wrapped in. It is the same family of words Paul uses when he tells believers to “put on Christ” and to “put on the new man.” Jesus did not say the Spirit would visit you. He said the Spirit would clothe you.

Somebody needs to hear that this morning. The power you have been crying out for is not coming. It has come. You are not waiting on power. Power is waiting on you to wake up to what you already wear.

This is not the power of personality. It is not the power of education or finances or social standing. It is not the power of a strong year or a strong season. This is power from on high. The same power that raised Christ from the dead now lives in mortal bodies (Romans 8:11). That kind of power. In you.

But notice the instruction Jesus tied to the promise: tarry. Wait first. Do not move out of step. The disciples did not run out into the streets in their own strength. They tarried in Jerusalem. They prayed. They came together with one accord. And then the power fell. Anointed action always follows anointed waiting. Strength comes from posture before it comes through performance.

Beloved, hear this: whatever you have been facing in your own strength is too small for who you really are. You were not given a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and a sound mind (2 Timothy 1:7). The clothing of the Spirit is not a future promise you have to qualify for. If you belong to Christ, you are already wearing it. The question is whether you will walk like you know it.

Today, rise like a son. Walk like a daughter. Step out of every place you have been intimidated by what is in front of you and step into the awareness of what is upon you. You are endued. You are clothed. You are not alone in the room. The same Spirit who set the upper room on fire is in you right now, and He does not flicker.

Prayer

Father, thank You that I have not been left to my own strength. Your Spirit has clothed me with power from on high, and that clothing is not a reward for performance but a gift through Jesus Christ. Open my eyes to what I am wearing. Help me move in step with You today. Wherever I have been shrinking back, let me rise. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am not waiting for power. I have been endued with power from on high. The same Spirit who raised Christ from the dead lives in me. I do not move in my own strength. I move clothed. I walk anointed. I rise.

Go Deeper in the Word

  • Acts 1:8: You shall receive power when the Holy Spirit comes
  • Romans 8:11: The Spirit who raised Christ lives in you
